The '''Shrine of Contemplation''' was one of the ancient [[Voss (species)|Voss]] temples located near the [[Interpreter's Retreat]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. The shrine's archives contained valuable [[Force artifact/Legends|Force artifacts]] and records documenting [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] influence on [[Voss (species)|Voss]].<ref name="TOR:SotS" />

==History==
[[File:SOC_inside.png|thumb|250px|left|Inside of the shrine during the restoration process.]]
Like the two other shrines located in the area, the [[Shrine of Judgment]] and the [[Shrine of Silence]], the Shrine of Judgment sustained heavy damage during the [[Invasion of Voss]] by the [[Eternal Empire]]. After the war, the Voss and [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] created the [[Shrine Restoration Initiative]] as a joint effort to restore the damaged shrines.<ref name="TOR:OW">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Old Wounds|Voss}}</ref>

Around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.3}}</ref> a team of [[Czerka Interstellar|Czerka]] mercenaries led by [[Kaya Natari]] [[Czerka invasion of Voss|broke]] into the Shrine of Contemplation in order to steal the relics kept in the temple. Eventually, the Czerka forces were defeated by the [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="TOR:SotS" />
